Node 2: rectangle 'Pre processing' (two lines: 'Pre' / 'processing'), pale-yellow fill, blue outline. Node 3: rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Extraction'), pale-cyan fill, blue outline. Node 4: rectangle 'Feature Selection' (two lines: 'Feature' / 'Selection'), pale-green fill, green outline. Node 5: rectangle 'Classification' (one line), dark-red fill, white text. Node 6: rectangle 'Classifier Output' (two lines: 'Classifier' / 'Output'), tan fill, dark-maroon outline. Connectors: one curved red arrow from the bottom of 'Training Data' curving down and right into the left edge of 'Pre processing'; four straight horizontal red arrows with solid triangular arrowheads: Pre processing -> Feature Extraction, Feature Extraction -> Feature Selection, Feature Selection -> Classification, Classification -> Classifier Output

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle border around the content area (roughly 0.4 cm inset), and a second thin red rectangle inset further to serve as the flowchart container. 3. At top center, type the title 'The Complete ML Classification Process' in bold Arial ~32pt; color all words red (#C00000) except 'ML' in blue (#0000CC). 4. Build the pipeline left to right on one horizontal row: (a) an oval with peach fill #FCE0C0 and dark-red #800000 outline, text 'Training Data' on two lines, placed above-left of the row; (b) rectangle, fill #FFFFCC, blue #0000CC border, text 'Pre processing' (two lines); (c) rectangle, fill #CCFFFF, blue border, text 'Feature Extraction' (two lines); (d) rectangle, fill #E8FFE8, green #008000 border, text 'Feature Selection' (two lines); (e) rectangle, fill #A00000, no visible border, text 'Classification' in white bold; (f) rectangle, fill #D9A870, maroon #800000 border, text 'Classifier Output' (two lines). All node text bold black ~16-18pt, centered, except Classification which is white. 5. Add a curved red arrow from the bottom of the Training Data oval into the left edge of 'Pre processing' (elbow/curved connector, red #C00000, triangular arrowhead). 6. Add four straight red right-pointing arrows between consecutive pipeline boxes. 7. Below 'Classification', add a gray (#D9D9D9) rounded rectangle with darker gray border and black bold text 'Apply Model'. 8. To its right, insert a 16-point star/explosion shape with pale-yellow #FFFFE0 fill and gray outline; add red bold text 'Based on' / 'Trained Model!'. 9. Draw a horizontal red dashed line across the container at ~61% height. 10. Below the dashed line add three gray rounded rectangles with black bold text: bottom-left 'Based on your inspection' / 'You select the techniques'; lower left-center 'Handcrafted features' / '(by You)'; center 'Your decision' / 'And using which' / 'approach'. 11. At bottom right insert a second star/explosion shape, white fill, gray outline, with blue bold text 'Based on' / 'Human Experience'. 12. Optionally add a small mouse-cursor icon near the 'Your decision' box for exact fidelity. 13. Do not add slide numbers, footers, or watermarks; none exist on the original.
